text:
cheng: Quick sync — I'm prepping a mirror for zeta-13b weights from HF to our S3 registry. Need a quick pass on path layout + checksum gating before I kick the job off.

maria: Thanks. Can you paste the HF repo path? also any special shard naming?

cheng: HF path is `https://huggingface.co/org/zeta-13b` but the weights are under `model-weights/` with shards named `pytorch_model-0000-of-00xx.bin`. We'll mirror into `s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v1/` and preserve the shard filenames.

alex: Is there a manifest file with sizes & checksums that we can use to validate after copy? we should avoid blind syncs.

cheng: There's a `manifest.json` in HF root but it's not canonical — different contributors uploaded via different tools. I opened a quick lint script:
```bash
python tools/generate_manifest.py --source hf://org/zeta-13b --out manifest-canonical.json
# computes sha256 and expected byte sizes per shard
```
I want to run that and then mirror with a checksum verify step.

ida: heads up — tokenizer team flagged a pad/cls token id mismatch for zeta-13b variants. If we mirror the v1 artifacts we should also include the checked `tokenizer.json` and `tokenizer_config.json` from HF; otherwise serving can mis-index positions.

maria: good catch. can you confirm which tokenizer files are authoritative? sometimes HF has `tokenizer.json` + `spm.model` + `tokenizer_config.json`.

cheng: Authoritative set: `tokenizer.json`, `vocab.txt`, and `tokenizer_config.json`. We'll copy them to `s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v1/tokenizer/`. For the pad id issue, my script will validate `tokenizer.json` "pad_id" against expected mapping file `tools/tokenizer_expected.json`.

alex: For IAM, which role will the mirror job assume? we need a temporary role for hf->mirror read and s3:PutObject to our bucket. Also presign TTL for downstream CI should be long enough for verify job.

cheng: Using `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ingest-mirror-runner`. Presign TTL set to 2h for the verify CI. ingest-bot will post presign URLs after upload.

ingest-bot: INFO: starting mirror job (job id: mirror-zeta13b-2026-03-18T12:04Z)
ingest-bot: PRESIGN: uploaded s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v1/pytorch_model-0000-of-0128.bin -> presign URL valid for 7200s

ida: small ask — can we also generate a lightweight config snapshot for serving that pins model dtype/quantization flags? otherwise runtime picks heuristics and we get regression. Something like: `serving_config.yml` with `dtype: float16, quantized: false, max_seq: 2048`.

cheng: agreed. will add `serving_config.yml` to the v1 folder. I'll attach the generated manifest + tokenizer checks to this thread once the dry-run finishes.

maria: code-review ping @cheng for the manifest script change — minor style nits but overall looks good. can you also paste the exact path for the canonical manifest when you post?

cheng: will do. ETA for dry run + verification: 45m. if all green, I'll promote to full mirror and tag `v1` in registry. :thumbsup:
